policy.purpose: Bilingual production copy, discovery metadata, relationships, and maintained commerce intents for canonical Wave 3 before runtime publication.
policy.relationship_rule: All relationship IDs must resolve inside the canonical 100. Relationships are visual-discovery aids, not unsourced historical-origin claims.
policy.commerce_rule: Only maintained canonical queries may be sent to Amazon. Free-text user search is never forwarded.
policy.qualification_rule: The seven qualified terms remain explicitly representative families/styles/weaves rather than being presented as one universal fixed motif.
policy.publication_gate: Do not merge these records into runtime data until all 20 reference images are generated, dimension-validated, visually reviewed, search/compare regressions pass, static JA/EN routes and SEO are generated, commerce mappings validate, and desktop/mobile Chromium QA pass.

definition.ja: 直線が直角に折れながら連続し、帯状に反復するメアンダー文様です。色ではなく、途切れず続く直角の折れ線構造が識別の中心です。

ジグザグよりも矩形の回り込みが明確
